scope: Only bounded central supervisor stdout/stderr rotation; no profiles, central node, Android or model runs.

initialIntegrationFailure.outcome: Noisy supervisor exit code null after helper 60 second deadline; preceding live restore/upgrade/profile checks had passed.
initialIntegrationFailure.causalLimit: The 60 second timeout did not reproduce in isolation. Parallel disk contention is plausible but not established as the sole cause.

diagnosis: Original implementation performs synchronous stat/append/chmod for every sanitized line. High output amplifies filesystem work even though privacy and storage bounds remain correct.

change.flush: Every child data event, stream end, spawn error and child close; no timer-delayed output.
change.diskFailure: Stop further log writes, terminate child, preserve failure exit status.

sameGeneratedWorkload.measurementLimit: One isolated pre-change and one isolated post-change full workload with identical fs-call instrumentation. This is not a broad performance benchmark.
